import json,collections
x=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
y=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
for n,m,note in [(14,'raised dot','Small rounded mark above baseline; irregular edges.'),(20,'unreadable','Blurred ink has more than one indistinct component.')]:
 r=x[n-1];y[n-1].update(answer=next(k for k,v in r['options'].items() if v==m),confidence='low',note=note)
open('answers.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in y))
assert len(x)==len(y)==89
assert len({r['item_id'] for r in y})==89
for r,a in zip(x,y):
 assert r['item_id']==a['item_id']
 assert a['answer'] in r['options']
 assert a['confidence'] in ['high','low']
 assert set(a)=={'item_id','answer','confidence','note'}
c=collections.Counter(r['options'][a['answer']] for r,a in zip(x,y))
print('Validated count, order, option letters: 89')
for m in ['raised dot','baseline dot','comma','hyphen or dash','space','nothing','other','unreadable']:print(m,c[m])
print('low-confidence',sum(a['confidence']=='low' for a in y))
